items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: And Ron Elliott(?) looked at him like Jabbo, Jabbo wasn't... But none of them could understand....

ctx.x: Mmm-hmm. And Ron Elliott(?)...See, Jabbo didn't know me. So I went on to tell him, give him some courage, because he was kind of down, see. [CHEWING, INAUDIBLE SENTENCE] And I went on to tell them how important Jabbo was and what a great trumpet player he was, and he was a rival of Louis. Because at this (?) his lip was done, and he stayed off to himself, which he ....(?). But this guy can play, man. When his lip got up, that band went to Europe, he was something else. But Ron Elliott(?) looked at him like Jabbo,…
